params.letterhead: Riverside General Hospital - Discharge medication list

values.med_1: Amlodipine 5 mg: 1 tablet by mouth once daily. Continue.
values.med_2: Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg: 1 tablet by mouth twice daily. CHANGED: dose lowered from 50 mg.
values.med_3: Atorvastatin 40 mg: 1 tablet by mouth at bedtime. Continue.
values.med_4: Furosemide 20 mg: 1 tablet by mouth every morning. NEW.
values.stop_1: Lisinopril 10 mg: STOP. Do not take.

params.letterhead: Riverside General Hospital - Going home instructions

values.diagnosis: Heart failure with fluid overload; blood pressure medicines adjusted.
values.avoid: Do not take ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) or naproxen (Aleve): they can worsen heart failure.
values.call_if: Weight up more than 3 lb in 2 days, new swelling, or short of breath: call the clinic.
